name: cl_Ag27Cu7
title: Ag27Cu7 nanoalloy
description: Gas-phase Ag27Cu7 nanoalloy (geometry plus homotop / chemical-ordering search). With the Gupta potential the GM is a perfect core-shell polyicosahedron (pIh7, D5h) with a Cu7 pentagonal-bipyramid core under a 27-atom Ag shell (Rossi et al., PRL 93, 105503 (2004)); NEP89 reproduces this structure.
